howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.step1Desc: Fill out the form with your destination, dates, number of travelers, and approximate budget. With that information I look for the best options adapted to what you need.
howItWorks.step2Desc: I present a personalized proposal with flights, accommodation... We review it together and adjust whatever is necessary until it fits perfectly with you.
howItWorks.step3Title: 3. You confirm and we manage everything
howItWorks.step3Desc: Once you approve the proposal, we take care of managing and booking flights, hotel and activities on your behalf. You don't have to do anything.
howItWorks.step4Desc: We manage each booking directly with airlines, accommodations and suppliers. You receive all the confirmations and documentation ready to travel.
howItWorks.step5Desc: Before your departure you receive all the organized documentation. And if you want to take your trip to the next level, add our orientation pack — day-by-day itinerary, visual map on Google and places of interest selected by us.
